title: Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun

paragraphs.text: Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun , shortened to The Astrotorium , is a space carnival that travels a galaxy in the Un-iverse . It was the setting of the Unfinity expansion.

The Astrotorium was founded "a tactically unspecified number of years ago" when Myra launched a roller coaster into space. It is a series of interconnected flying spaceships that can move from planet to planet. It is orbited by a "trash belt." The park is themed after Magic: The Gathering IP, although Myra doesn't pay to license it.
The Astrotorium travels through space, visiting different planets throughout multiple star systems and galaxies.

Blorb-12 , the beautiful home planet of the Blorbians, including Ambassador Blorpityblorpboop , their de facto leader. Blorbian children are called grublings. They do not use human genders. The planet was obliterated by Captain Rex Nebula in a parking accident when he backed the amusement park over it. As part of the resolution of 382 BG.2d 83 ( Blorpityblorpboop et al. v. Nebula ), the survivors received lifetime passes as compensation, and now live for free in park hotels, receiving three meal tickets a day. Because of their life in the park, they have become unbeatable at all of its arcade games.
Glurg . An ocean planet. Home of galactopods, sharks , and Stephan .
The Astrotorium's midway features numerous attractions, including amusement park rides and carnival games. Its staff is composed almost entirely of Vampires .

The astropark hosts numerous races as Employees , Guests , and Performers as it travels between planets. Employee teams include Ride Operations, Visitor Services, Vomit Removal, and the Gift Shop. The park's performers are in a union with mandated breaks and snacks. Papparazzi often visit the park to view the influencers and interstellar television stars that visit, including Solaflora , Harvey Galaxy , and Interstellar Greg . Park guests are rarely accidentally beheaded.

All of the park's animals have complete agency. The park is contending with four concurrent infestations that each predate on each other: Beebles , Gremlins , Rats , and Squirrels , though Myra considers The Most Dangerous Gamer to be a fifth.
